author: DarkerTable
name: Nikon D300 Input Color Profile Presets
description: Get colors out of your Nikon D300 raw files that finally match the in-camera JPEGs. This pack contains two auto-apply presets that set up darktable to use genuine Nikon input color profiles extracted from Capture NX-D, Capture NX 2 or ViewNX-i: an 'unbreak input profile' preset with the correct gamma settings, and an 'input color profile' preset that selects the Nikon neutral profile with a linear Rec.2020 working profile and gamut clipping disabled. They accompany a detailed guide on discuss.pixls.us that walks you through extracting and renaming the Nikon .icm profiles the presets are designed to work with.
